phase: Phase 3 — Build Beautiful Websites with CSS
description: Change layouts based on screen size.
definition: Media queries apply styles when specified conditions match.
rule: A minimum width query can add a wider layout when space is available.
tip: Write the narrow layout first, then add larger-screen adjustments.
caution: Choose breakpoints where the content needs them, rather than by device names.
exercise: Stack two cards on mobile and place them together on wider screens.
